name: Waypoint Teleports
description: /unstuck frees a stuck player (a short hop to free ground nearby, else a /home to their spawn point) and /home takes them to their spawn point, for every player, after a short countdown standing still; cooldowns, an optional cost, no /home inside the shroud. Admins get tp, bring, tp.pos, tp.back and tp.list. Moves players the way the game's own fast travel does. Host or dedicated server; players who join need nothing. Installed switched off.

settings.label: Search for ground from (m above)
settings.help: The game's ground search looks about 10 m around that point; when it finds nothing, the player goes to their spawn point.

settings.label: Not within (s) of a hit
settings.help: No escape from a fight: /unstuck waits this long after the last hit on you.

settings.label: Not within (s) of a hit
settings.help: No escape from a fight: /home waits this long after the last hit on you (also /unstuck's way home).

settings.label: Cost: item (empty: free)
settings.help: The item's name as the console's items command lists it. Taken when the teleport happens, given back if it fails.

settings.label: Also inside the shroud
settings.help: Off: like the game's fast travel, not from inside the shroud.

settings.label: Countdown (s)
settings.help: /unstuck and /home wait this long; moving 2 m cancels them.

settings.default: unstuck home tp bring tp.pos tp.back tp.list
settings.label: Commands
settings.help: The commands that work here, separated by spaces. tp, bring, tp.pos, tp.back and tp.list are for admins only.
